name: Client Page Spacing
description: Implemented global layout spacing rules in mobile.scss so that when a hero banner is followed directly by plain text, paragraph, or standard headings, a 4rem (64px) vertical spacing is applied. If the banner is followed directly by a full-width background block (e.g., video embed, project TOC, region showcase, cover or group section), the spacing is automatically collapsed to zero to prevent gaps.

name: Conditional Project Eyebrow
description: Implemented pure CSS rules targeting .project-section__eyebrow using body:not(:has(.project-section ~ .project-section)) to dynamically hide the "Project 1" label on client pages or mockups that only contain a single project, while keeping it visible on pages with multiple projects.

name: Client Services Tagging & Detail Pages
description: Programmatic database tagging is complete, and the client detail pages now render a standardized, centered E3 brand hero banner matching the Cooke County style, complete with custom logo and background media parsed dynamically from the post content.

name: Project Details Column Layout
description: Added style block options (2-Column Grid and 3-Column Grid) for Gutenberg List blocks natively in WordPress, and updated Boyd ISD's project details list block to display in a 2-column grid.

name: Full-Width Layout & Spacing
description: Collapsed margins between the intro banner and the following background blocks, and constrained layout widths.

name: Clients Page Improvements
description: Added breadcrumbs and removed rounded corners from all cards and filter elements.

name: Story Page Linked Quotes
description: Migrated the Story page testimonials to be dynamically linked to the CPT quotes and people posts rather than manually embedded. Created the Leadership Team quote and person CPT records, and fixed the block renderer query key mismatch.

name: Client Index Page Filter
description: Restricted the directory listing to show only the 25 user-specified clients.

name: Favicon Recovery
description: Restored the E3 green circle logo favicon.ico and removed the default Astro favicon.svg to solve the tab icon regression.

name: Team Page Grid & Hover Layout
description: Modified the grid to a 4-column layout, removed card hover translation, fixed the grayscale-to-color transition, and ordered by post menu order.

name: Map Section Spacing & Overlap
description: Constrained the green Texas map background section's desktop padding to exactly 100px top and bottom. Set the map column to be absolutely positioned on desktop, preventing it from stretching the green background height, and letting it spill over into adjacent white sections.

name: Breadcrumbs to Banner Spacing
description: Removed the white padding gap at the top of services-page content and excluded services-page container from first-child margin overrides, allowing banners and full-width background blocks to flush cleanly against the breadcrumb bar.
